description.html: This 45x40x120 cm glass aquarium with a volume of 216 liters is made from glass whose thickness matches this volume, with silicone joints that guarantee long-lasting watertightness. Its 120 cm height gives it a striking vertical format that takes up little floor space.

The larger volume allows you to keep larger species such as angelfish and discus, or a community with several schools of smaller fish. More stable water parameters in a larger volume mean less stress for the fish and less frequent intervention.

We build custom aquariums: any dimensions, glass thickness matched to the volume, optional openings for filters and heaters. Call us or message us on WhatsApp for a consultation and a price. Delivery to all cities in Serbia.
